1003-5006-7272-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.

Repeat.

2893-4762-6168-8289.easyPrerequisites:
You control five or more Forests.
Fertilid has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2893-4762-6168-8289.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest enters, Obuun and Roiling Canopy trigger.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Roiling Canopy trigger, giving Devoted Druid +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2893-4762-6168-8289.notes: Each loop, Devoted Druid will net +1/+1. This can let you gain more {G}, and that {G} can then fetch non-Forest basic lands with Fertilid.

4191-4518.description:

When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5078-6918-7295-8171.description:

1479-2841-6528-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6528-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-5626-5687-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
586-5626-5687-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Repeat.

1651-1770-2638-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-2638-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.

Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.

If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.

Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.

Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn.

When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1170-1750-3584-6776.easyPrerequisites: A nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn, or a spell was warped this turn.
1170-1750-3584-6776.notablePrerequisites: You have cast an instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.

Cast Roving Actuator by paying {3}{R}.
When Roving Actuator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Pull from Eternity from your graveyard, and then copying it and casting the copy without paying its mana cost, targeting any card you own in exile.
Displacer Kitten and Thousand-Year Storm trigger, with Displacer Kitten targeting Roving Actuator.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying the Pull from Eternity spell at least once, targeting the original Pull from Eternity.
Resolve the copy of the Pull from Eternity Spell from step 4, putting Pull from Eternity from exile into your graveyard.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Roving Actuator.
Repeat from step 2.

When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-5223-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.
